$description: hzero brand tokens: the one source for colours and type. The brand site reads this file directly; the website (web/assets/site.css) and the chart package (notebooks/hzero_charts) should follow it. Change a value here first.

primary.name: Charcoal
primary.use: The page. Black with a trace of cyan; never pure #000.

primary.name: Ink
primary.use: All text on charcoal. White (#FFFFFF) on paper and slides.

primary.name: hzero cyan
primary.pms: Spot colour, to choose from a printed proof
primary.use: One signal per screen: the logo bracket, the hero highlight, the Contact button.

secondary.name: Signal green
secondary.use: The highlighted part of section titles and the lit state in the sphere. Never next to cyan in one element.

secondary.name: Deep cyan
secondary.use: Links, small highlights and chart accents on white. 4.8:1 on white.

greys.name: Steel
greys.use: Second lines of titles, captions. Large text only.

greys.name: Mist
greys.use: Logo bracket on light, diagram lines, secondary text on dark.

greys.name: Fog
greys.use: Alternate sections and panels on light. Hairlines #E2E7E8.
